geometry.phase_window_scope: One alignment per relative apex--Moon phase cycle in this circular coplanar model; not the real lunar launch-window calendar.
geometry.scope: Circular coplanar impulsive zero-SOI conics, variable tangential apex release. No 3D plane transition, finite-SOI or finite-thrust design.

mission.structural_fraction_denominator: Each component dry/(component dry+own total propellant); excludes carried payload.
mission.integer_cycle_scope: Sum of separately bounded outbound-ready and post-touchdown-return tail; never subtract two independent ceilings to derive a tail.
mission.net_cargo_mass_scope: Delivered payload includes packaging. Usable water fraction is separate.
mission.recurring_lift_scope: All return propellant leaves apex initially. Returned dry structures lifted only once; no lunar refuelling.
mission.time_scope: Declared operations and phase-wait budget before additional receiving queue. Not a calibrated real-world flight-time guarantee.
mission.scope: Finite conceptual mission catalogue. No real 3D, finite-SOI, finite-thrust, structural, cryogenic, nuclear-safety or capture-tolerance certification; not a global trajectory optimum.

baseline.name: stock_all
baseline.scope: All one-year usable water initially on Moon; at most declared isolatedC loss events. Initial-water transport route is chosen independently by integrated model.
baseline.hardware_service_life_assumption: Storage tanks are delivered and commissioned during late prepositioning, with at least the modeled one-year rated service after commissioning. No centuries-long storage durability is assumed.
baseline.guarantee_boundary: Quantity only; long-duration water quality, thermal control and isolation require engineering evidence.

processor.scope: Capacity modules are design units; mass, power, cost and water quality require separately stated engineering inputs. K is after the declared number of modules is unavailable.

components.E_staging_scope: All one-year new cargo and retained propellant staged at one fixed-capacity harbour before habitation; reusable dry hulls charged separately with explicit reuse credit by integrated model.

demand_1.hardware_service_life_assumption: Water modules and tanks are delivered and commissioned in the late prepositioning stage, not assumed functional after centuries of early storage. The integrated ledger must subtract included water hardware from generic construction and deliver those identified critical items separately. At least one year of rated service after commissioning is assumed, not empirically calibrated.

certificate.scope: Sufficient daily-quantity guarantee, independent capture/processor calendars; arbitrary correlations within declared rolling supports. Not exact minimum reserve or a shortage probability.
certificate.conservatism: Minimum of two independently proved safe loss/backlog envelopes; separate calendar budgets remain explicit. Sufficient reserve, not a minimum-reserve theorem.

processor.scope: Capacity modules are design units; mass, power, cost and water quality require separately stated engineering inputs. K is after the declared number of modules is unavailable.

fleet_certificate.scope: Finite dispatch horizon only; spare hulls are initially at the dispatch side, not automatically lunar-landed mass. Each loss is recognized within cycle_days. No unlimited-lifetime guarantee with finite hull stock.

components.tank_fault_model: Single union of raw/fresh isolated-compartment incidents; raw loss is eta*raw_t in the recovered-water-equivalent ledger, at mostC. Each reservoir class has its own capacity spare. Repair<=Pdays.
components.source_scope: Conditional designed service calendar and mission interface; not observations or empirical availability.
components.R_vehicle_scope: R vehicles are expended; their manufacture, propellant and operations belong in each launch cost parameter. No reusable R hull pool is assumed.
components.cargo_hull_support_scope: The cargo-loss budget includes every loss before successful delivery, including cargo destroyed with a hull. The permanent-hull budget may also include losses on the empty return. These are not added as two disjoint pre-delivery cargo-loss budgets.
components.E_staging_scope: All one-year new cargo and retained propellant staged at one fixed-capacity harbour before habitation; reusable dry hulls charged separately with explicit reuse credit by integrated model.

counted_faults_1.5.guarantee_boundary: Domestic/medical service-water scope; agricultural/industrial/cooling water flows require added inputs. Isolation, purification quality, storage aging and module performance are engineering assumptions.
counted_faults_1.5.hardware_service_life_assumption: Water modules and tanks are delivered and commissioned in the late prepositioning stage, not assumed functional after centuries of early storage. At least one year of rated service after commissioning is assumed, not empirically calibrated.

propellant_loss_0.name: stock_all

propellant_loss_0.guarantee_boundary: Quantity only; long-duration water quality, thermal control and isolation require engineering evidence.

certificate.scope: Sufficient daily-quantity guarantee, independent capture/processor calendars; arbitrary correlations within declared rolling supports. Not exact minimum reserve or a shortage probability.
certificate.conservatism: Minimum of two independently proved safe loss/backlog envelopes; separate calendar budgets remain explicit. Sufficient reserve, not a minimum-reserve theorem.

processor.scope: Capacity modules are design units; mass, power, cost and water quality require separately stated engineering inputs. K is after the declared number of modules is unavailable.

fleet_certificate.scope: Finite dispatch horizon only; spare hulls are initially at the dispatch side, not automatically lunar-landed mass. Each loss is recognized within cycle_days. No unlimited-lifetime guarantee with finite hull stock.

components.tank_fault_model: Single union of raw/fresh isolated-compartment incidents; raw loss is eta*raw_t in the recovered-water-equivalent ledger, at mostC. Each reservoir class has its own capacity spare. Repair<=Pdays.
components.source_scope: Conditional designed service calendar and mission interface; not observations or empirical availability.
components.R_vehicle_scope: R vehicles are expended; their manufacture, propellant and operations belong in each launch cost parameter. No reusable R hull pool is assumed.
components.cargo_hull_support_scope: The cargo-loss budget includes every loss before successful delivery, including cargo destroyed with a hull. The permanent-hull budget may also include losses on the empty return. These are not added as two disjoint pre-delivery cargo-loss budgets.
components.E_staging_scope: All one-year new cargo and retained propellant staged at one fixed-capacity harbour before habitation; reusable dry hulls charged separately with explicit reuse credit by integrated model.

power_limit_4000.scope: Finite catalogue, sufficient quantity/service certificates. Multi-zone candidates use distinct source reservations, independent inventories and one redundant processor per fault-mode zone; they do not rely on an unproved pooled inventory policy.
power_limit_4000.guarantee_boundary: Domestic/medical service-water scope; agricultural/industrial/cooling water flows require added inputs. Isolation, purification quality, storage aging and module performance are engineering assumptions.
power_limit_4000.hardware_service_life_assumption: Water modules and tanks are delivered and commissioned in the late prepositioning stage, not assumed functional after centuries of early storage. The integrated ledger must subtract included water hardware from generic construction and deliver those identified critical items separately. At least one year of rated service after commissioning is assumed, not empirically calibrated.

coefficient_scenarios.scenario_identity: Illustrative constant-technology coefficient cases; not future quotations, forecasts or probability intervals.
coefficient_scenarios.time_basis: Undiscounted constant-technology spending exposure. No inflation, financing, learning, technological obsolescence, or present-value interpretation.
coefficient_scenarios.price_boundary: R_flight_services includes vehicle/propellant/flight-specific launch services, but excludes separately charged standing-facility upkeep. E lift energy, nonenergy handling, propellant purchase, hull manufacturing and overhaul are separate. Annual upkeep is a service-renewal accounting coefficient, not an assertion that one physical asset lasts centuries.
incomplete_environment: Stratospheric soot/black carbon, NOx, water-vapour and ozone chemistry
Nuclear/radiological impacts of the orbital tug
Tether and infrastructure material manufacturing, land/ocean ecology, noise, debris and accident consequences
coefficient_scenarios.sunk_infrastructure: The task starts after the space-elevator system is built. Historic construction of that pre-existing system is excluded from incremental spending; continued operations/renewal are charged. New hull and water equipment manufacturing is charged. Warehouse and receiving capacity coefficients procure/reserve an exogenous ready service; provider deployment mass/time is outside the physical cargo ledger.
coefficient_scenarios.budget_identity: All allocated full jobs and equipment are conservatively committed, including potentially unlaunched tail stock. Values rank declared reserved-spending upper budgets, not exact realized expenditure or expected cost.

input_identity: All varied future capacities, device metrics, faults, losses and limits are declared scenarios. Lift changes are counterfactual capacity changes, not silently substituted for the fixed official baseline.
zero_fault_identity: The factor0 point removes counted operational faults and spare-module outages while retaining the separately declared transport jitter and propellant-retention scenario; it is not the main ideal-mode baseline.
catalogue_identity: Common coarse decision family: shares0,.25,.5,.75,1 plus the point-specific affine balancing share, preposition routesE orR, the matched and module_two homogeneous equipment packing rules, and all fifteen declared water architectures with explicit failures retained. The main catalogue also compares two other packing rules; its minima must not be conflated with this coarser sensitivity study. The fixed-two module rule is feasible at all tested5/20/50t module masses, preserving that same packing alternative when mass decreases.
interpretation: One-factor study around the same declared defaults. It does not cover every parameter interaction. A catalogue without certified policies is not a physical impossibility theorem. Cost units are the same illustrative coefficient scenarios, not empirical quotations or confidence intervals.
